# Test-run re-run through the v2.2 engine (generated by rerun_testrun.py)

Input: 62 judge JSONs from `7-geo-all-types/test-run/judge/` (unchanged). Weights 2.2-2026-10-25; weights identical to v2.1 apart from the new rule blocks: **True**.

compat (v2.2 engine, rules=v2.1) reproduces the v2.1 engine on 62/62 files.

## Deltas

- **Level rule alone** (level = ceiling; proposed levels ignored because no file has a downgrade_reason): mean +2.7, median +2, mean |d| 2.7, range +0..+8. Pages moved: 42/62. Criterion levels raised 127, lowered 0.
  - Split: criteria raised to 5 (all checks pass; v2.1 judges proposed 4) add 1.5 raw pts/page; criteria raised to a ceiling below 5 (judge proposed under the ceiling) add 1.3 raw pts/page.
- **v2.2 check rules on top** (na -> fail for missing blocks / U1 c4, case_study U9 anchor override): mean -0.2, median +0, mean |d| 0.2, range -3..+0. Pages moved: 6.
- **Total engine effect**: mean +2.5, median +2, mean |d| 2.5, range +0..+8. Band changes: 7 (01 Poor->Average, 05 Average->Good, 29 Poor->Average, 51 Average->Good, 53 Average->Good, 59_doc Average->Good, 60_doc Average->Good).
